programs.description: A devoted son is at a crossroads when his selfless and loving mother urges him to go life his life and leave her at an old age home.
Gopal, a slow learner, is pressured by his mother to keep up with his fellow students. Finally, he breaks down and runs away from his home after he is unable to cope with failing.

Officers in a small village police station stumble upon a stash of illegal drugs. However, they spend their entire day creating a complex fictional case against an innocent vegetable vendor.
An ambitious young woman moves to Chandigarh to pursue higher education and a better future. Her life takes a difficult turn when she falls into the wrong company and faces new challenges.
A young woman disappears, whose father, a dedicated social activist and small printing business owner, is ruthlessly murdered.
Chann, a newlywed, makes a grievous decision when her husband leaves for Canada, abruptly ceasing all communications with her.
An elderly couple faces a profound emotional struggle due to their deep attachment to their family home and must navigate their anxieties regarding the residence's future and its continued care.
A woman aged 45 desperately longs for a child despite being biologically unable to conceive. Meanwhile, her husband helplessly observes her emotional turmoil.
